screens.title: Your cart
screens.subtitle: Cart, quantity and order summary
screens.description: Edit quantities, remove or restore an item, and keep totals consistent. Top-up selections return here with the chosen allowance.
screens.backend: Cart lines and quotes must come from the commerce backend. Revalidate totals before payment.

screens.title: Traveller & receipt
screens.subtitle: Delivery details before payment
screens.description: A focused receipt-email form with a gifting intention, without inventing a shipping address for a digital product.
screens.backend: Validate email on the server; purchasing for someone is not the same as unlocking transfer.

screens.title: Payment methods
screens.subtitle: Choose a payment route
screens.description: Saved card, wallet and redirect options use one selection pattern and one clear total. No real card details are collected here.
screens.backend: Show only PSP methods actually supported by device, currency and country.

screens.title: Bank approval
screens.subtitle: Authentication in context
screens.description: Keep the order visible while authentication happens, with a safe return to payment selection.
screens.backend: Use the PSP’s hosted 3DS flow. Never collect bank login or OTP inside an Openline imitation.

screens.title: Checking payment
screens.subtitle: Unknown outcome, without a second charge
screens.description: A calm pending state with status checking, failure recovery and no duplicate pay button.
screens.backend: Reconcile the original payment intent and webhook. A timeout is not proof of failure or success.

screens.title: Order receipt
screens.subtitle: A useful, detailed receipt
screens.description: View line items, total, payment method and the purchased code; continue to the order or code rather than forcing activation.
screens.backend: Use server-confirmed paid status, receipt details and actual taxes. The example totals are design fixtures.

screens.title: Purchase-code details
screens.subtitle: A purchase is not an installed eSIM
screens.description: One place for the code, purchase status and the Activate / Gift / Keep choices. Activated codes no longer offer transfer.
screens.backend: Authenticate the purchaser and return validation, redemption and transfer status without consuming the code.

screens.title: Unlock for gifting
screens.subtitle: An explicit transfer decision
screens.description: Explain owner validation and the risk of anyone with the code redeeming it; require a separate confirmation.
screens.backend: Verify ownership and unused status, record the unlock and preserve the owner-email validation step.

screens.title: Your gift is ready
screens.subtitle: Share a useful gift message
screens.description: Copy the unlocked code with clear redemption instructions, without activating it or claiming an email was sent.
screens.backend: The system share route is a separate native implementation. Never expose code-bearing links in analytics.

screens.title: Received a gift
screens.subtitle: Recipient entry and eligibility
screens.description: Review a gift without starting it, handle a locked code and proceed only when eligible.
screens.backend: Validate gift eligibility atomically again when redeeming. Never disclose sender account details.

screens.title: Waiting for the owner
screens.subtitle: Pending owner validation
screens.description: Keep the recipient informed, provide a sender-help message and allow rechecking without bypassing validation.
screens.backend: Only a verified server transition can make a pending gift eligible. No email is sent in this reference.

screens.title: Ready to start?
screens.subtitle: Consent before validity begins
screens.description: A large, off-by-default readiness switch and a concise confirmation before the purchase code is consumed.
screens.backend: Use current Openline rules: checking does not activate; confirmed activation begins validity and ends gifting.

screens.title: Creating your eSIM
screens.subtitle: Provisioning and safe recovery
screens.description: Progress, retry and success states stay within the same process rather than losing the purchase-code context.
screens.backend: Use an idempotent provisioning operation, poll safely, and reconcile unknown outcomes before retrying.

screens.title: Your eSIM profile
screens.subtitle: QR first, manual details nearby
screens.description: Readable QR, copyable SM-DP+ address and activation code, ICCID and a second-device option.
screens.backend: Replace the non-installable fixture with authenticated profile details. EID is a device identifier, not an invented profile field.

screens.title: Install your eSIM
screens.subtitle: Platform-specific install help
screens.description: Keep the QR in view and explain the iPhone or Android route in short, readable steps.
screens.backend: Native installation links must use supported OS APIs and real provisioning data. Do not promise one-tap installation universally.

screens.title: Set your mobile data
screens.subtitle: Four settings that matter
screens.description: Primary data, other-line data, switching and roaming are explicit checks, not a claim that the app changed settings.
screens.backend: Treat these as user confirmations. The browser cannot configure the device’s mobile-data settings.

screens.title: Make it yours
screens.subtitle: A coherent finish
screens.description: Connection guidance ends with a profile label, folder and a clear route into the account.
screens.backend: Provisioned, installed and physically connected are different states. Use actual evidence before asserting connectivity in production.

screens.title: Japan eSIM
screens.subtitle: Everyday profile management
screens.description: A legible usage card, plan details, quick actions and a useful route back to setup or support.
screens.backend: All usage, validity, network and allowance values need authoritative subscription data.

screens.title: Label & folder
screens.subtitle: Quick profile organisation
screens.description: Change a short label and folder without restarting activation; Cancel discards edits.
screens.backend: Persist changes to the authenticated owner. UI validation limits here are design choices, not established product rules.

screens.title: Your folders
screens.subtitle: A tidy travel workspace
screens.description: Create folders, browse their contents and move a profile with a clear empty state.
screens.backend: Scope folders to the correct account and retain membership consistently across devices.

screens.title: Add more data
screens.subtitle: Top-up eligibility and selection
screens.description: Compare fixed allowances, then review the actual cart before paying. Do not promise every profile supports top-up.
screens.backend: Quote supported products and confirm whether the existing profile can be used or a replacement is needed.

screens.title: Usage & alerts
screens.subtitle: Useful usage information
screens.description: Consistent fixed-plan arithmetic and threshold controls, with functional chart labels instead of decorative telemetry.
screens.backend: Usage may be delayed. Notification toggles require permission and durable account settings.

screens.title: Let’s get you online
screens.subtitle: A guided no-service checklist
screens.description: Use the same installation recommendations as Start, with short actionable steps and a support handoff.
screens.backend: Do not infer the user’s settings or radio condition from checklist clicks.

screens.title: About your speed
screens.subtitle: Fixed versus unlimited, honestly
screens.description: Explain the fixed-allowance guarantee, local MNO rules for unlimited and a best-effort alternative route.
screens.backend: No universal speed, threshold, midnight reset or guaranteed improvement is promised.

screens.title: Another route
screens.subtitle: Consent before profile replacement
screens.description: Keep the current eSIM until support advises otherwise and request review before any installation or validity changes.
screens.backend: Availability, cost and balance/validity carry-over require product confirmation. No silent profile replacement.

screens.title: Openline support
screens.subtitle: Knowledge, AI, then people
screens.description: A short contextual conversation, suggested prompts and an explicit human-review path.
screens.backend: Connect real ticket/AI/human systems before claiming messages were delivered or an agent joined.

screens.title: Orders & receipts
screens.subtitle: Order history beyond success
screens.description: Paid and pending-refund entries with receipt access and a clear status timeline.
screens.backend: Use the real payment/refund ledger; do not invent refund deadlines or instantly resolved disputes.

screens.title: Privacy & account
screens.subtitle: Deliberate sensitive actions
screens.description: Clear privacy preferences and separate export/deletion request confirmations with verification requirements.
screens.backend: Account export/deletion requires authenticated server workflows and retention-policy disclosure, not a local UI reset.

flows.name: Purchase & payment
flows.description: From cart to a purchase code, with payment checks along the way.

flows.name: Give & receive
flows.description: Unlock deliberately. Let the recipient redeem when they are ready.

flows.name: Activate & connect
flows.description: Consent, provisioning, QR, phone settings and a clear finish.

flows.name: Manage your eSIMs
flows.description: A useful everyday workspace for profiles, folders, top-ups and usage.

flows.name: Find a better connection
flows.description: Troubleshoot, understand local rules and get a profile review.

flows.name: Orders & account
flows.description: Keep receipts accessible and sensitive account actions deliberate.

status: Additional proposals; review before production integration.
